# FAIL

## Requirement Summary

"When a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, the Unit Type dropdown must be populated with options filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant. After a Unit Type is selected, the Unit Size dropdown must be populated with options filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type."

## Reviewer Findings

- F2 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "How the selected Condenser Type should be used to filter Unit Type entries, given the example parent arrays only contain refrigerants." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on whether and how Condenser Type participates in Unit Type filtering."
- F3 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Whether the Condenser Type appears in the parent array of SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant entries or requires a separate mapping." | "Clarify from the ticket owner if Condenser Type is expected to be present in the parent array or if another mapping is needed."
- F4 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "What should be displayed or how the UI should behave when no entries match the filter criteria." | "Ask the ticket owner to define UI behavior for empty filter results."
- F5 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Whether the isActive flag must always be enforced or if inactive items can ever be shown." | "Clarify from the ticket owner whether inactive items should ever be presented to the user."
- F6 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "If the Unit Size filtering should also consider Condenser Type in addition to Refrigerant and Unit Type." | "Obtain clarification on whether Condenser Type is part of the Unit Size filtering criteria."
- F7 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The exact structure, pagination, and error handling of the /dropdowns API response is not defined." | "Request detailed API contract information for the /dropdowns endpoint, including response format, pagination, and error handling."

## Open Ambiguities

- /ambiguities/0 | "How the selected Condenser Type should be used to filter Unit Type entries, given the example parent arrays only contain refrigerants."
- /ambiguities/1 | "Whether the Condenser Type appears in the parent array of SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant entries or requires a separate mapping."
- /ambiguities/2 | "What should be displayed or how the UI should behave when no entries match the filter criteria."
- /ambiguities/3 | "Whether the isActive flag must always be enforced or if inactive items can ever be shown."
- /ambiguities/4 | "If the Unit Size filtering should also consider Condenser Type in addition to Refrigerant and Unit Type."
- /ambiguities/5 | "The exact structure, pagination, and error handling of the /dropdowns API response is not defined."

## Final Disposition

FAIL

- OPEN_FINDINGS
- OPEN_AMBIGUITIES
